component: Selected state: coloured curved left stripe on navigation and cards
explanation: Owner: the recurring curved emerald left border on selected navigation items and interactive cards is not part of the approved direction. A selected item is a subtle surface step plus type weight. (Principle 3 already forbids the arbitrary left border; the owner wants the selected navigation case stated.)

classification.rationale: P03 forbids the arbitrary left border as generic emphasis but allows it with an established semantic meaning; the selected navigation item is a case an agent may read either way. One sentence would settle it. Owner decides.
